title: Beyond Functional Correctness: Static Code Quality Profiling of LLM-Generated Code
abstract: arXiv:2610.19167v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, yet most evaluations still focus on whether generated code passes benchmark test suites. Functional correctness alone, however, provides only a limited view of quality: benchmark tests are often incomplete, and passing them does not guarantee that code is maintainable, reliable, or well-structured. This paper {presents a large-scale static quality profiling of} LLM-generated Python code, with a focus on maintainability and reliability. Using 65{,}663 programs from 73 models in LiveCodeBench, we evaluate generated code with established static analysis tools, including Pylint, Radon, and SonarQube. Our results show systematic differences across models that are not captured by correctness alone, with maintainability emerging as the clearest source of variation. We further find that correctness often comes with structural trade-offs rather than uniformly simpler solution

translated_title: 超越功能正确性：对大语言模型生成代码的静态代码质量剖析
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于代码生成，然而大多数评估仍然只关注生成的代码能否通过基准测试套件。然而，仅凭功能正确性只能提供对质量的有限认识：基准测试往往不完整，通过测试并不能保证代码是可维护的、可靠的或结构良好的。本文对LLM生成的Python代码进行了大规模的静态质量剖析，重点关注可维护性和可靠性。我们使用LiveCodeBench中73个模型的65,663个程序，采用Pylint、Radon和SonarQube等成熟的静态分析工具对生成的代码进行评估。我们的结果显示，各模型之间存在仅凭正确性指标无法捕捉的系统性差异，其中可维护性是最明显的差异来源。我们进一步发现，正确性往往伴随着结构上的权衡，而不是一致地对应更简单的解决方案。
tldr: 本研究对73个大语言模型生成的65,663个Python程序进行了大规模静态代码质量剖析，发现仅靠功能正确性无法全面评估代码质量，各模型在可维护性等静态质量指标上存在系统性差异，且正确性往往伴随着结构上的权衡。
